title: Fix deployment error

requirements.text: Diagnose and resolve the deployment failure that occurred when pushing code to the network
acceptanceCriteria: The application successfully deploys to the Internet Computer network
The deployment completes without throwing errors

requirements.text: Verify backend migration logic properly handles the upgrade from existing state to new state without data loss
acceptanceCriteria: Migration module correctly transforms old state to new state
All existing user data, videos, photos, playlists, and comments are preserved during upgrade
No runtime errors occur during canister upgrade process

requirements.text: Ensure all backend actor methods have proper type signatures and return values matching the candid interface
acceptanceCriteria: All public methods in main.mo match the expected candid interface
No type mismatches between Motoko implementation and candid definitions
Backend compiles without warnings or errors

requirements.text: Validate that frontend imports and actor integration code correctly reference the deployed backend canister
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend successfully connects to the backend actor after deployment
All API calls from hooks properly resolve to backend methods
No console errors related to actor initialization or canister communication

constraints: Must preserve all existing user data during migration
Must maintain compatibility with Internet Identity authentication
Must not modify immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
nonGoals: Changing the UI design or styling
